business_summary: Post Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: POST) is a diversified consumer packaged goods holding company. It produces and distributes egg products through its Michael Foods Group segment, a large branded foodservice egg-products position, and discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K; the mapping's role evidence states plainly that 'repeated outbreaks at third-party contracted laying facilities have removed material shares of its controlled egg supply,' a more direct causal statement than most names in this batch. The link is scored EMERGING (impact 60, crowdedness 42, capture 45, as of 2026-09-10): the chain's own rationale notes POST is institutionally saturated with 16.66% of its float short, trading at 80.28 against a 52-week range of 76.23 to 114.61, near the bottom, but still widely held and covered every time a facility is hit, hence 'findable, therefore not undiscovered.'

exposure_summary.narrative: POST holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (egg-processing, link position 9, EMERGING, money_corner false). No dollar magnitude is disclosed for the egg-supply losses at contracted facilities the mapping's role evidence describes; Post's segment reporting covers Michael Foods Group as a whole, not HPAI-driven supply disruption specifically.
